label: The Ember Road
summary: A caravan route across burned plains between two old empires, where magic is real and always costs something.

world.era: An age of old empires and new roads
world.setting: The Ember Road, a caravan route across the Ashen Marches
world.description: Waystations every day's ride, bandit-held ruins in between, and a sky that still glows at night from a war of mages three hundred years ago.
rules: Magic is real, rare and costly, and people notice when it is used
Monsters exist; fights are fast and dangerous
Gods are distant; people are not

narration.tone: Bold and adventurous, with room for wonder
